The '''Great Forest''' was a wooded area on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The forest was located west of expansive grass plains<ref name="COE 2">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/feature20081201.html|text=Castaways of Endor|int=Castaways of Endor}}</ref> and north of the [[Desert of Simoom]].<ref name="COE 3">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/feature20081201.html|text=Castaways of Endor|int=Castaways of Endor}}</ref>
